title: Chat routing when two packs claim the same message
goal: A message two enabled packs both claim is resolved predictably
acceptance: Test committed first: a phrase two packs match is asked back to the owner (or settled by a recorded rule), never silently routed to one
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-20: a claim step per pack and one conflict rule. Not a measurement.
